title: Navodaya Cricket League — season 6
location: RNS Institute of Technology Grounds, Bengaluru
summary: The sixth edition of the league.
body: The sixth season was played at the RNS Institute of Technology grounds in Bengaluru, with teams drawn from across the batches. It is as much a reunion as a tournament: teams are built around batches, so a season puts alumni from different generations on the same ground.
